files.purpose_guess: Current WRT 3-year plant forecasting workbook: a species by season by site grid (not yet filled in), roll-up summaries (mostly broken), and per-site planting histories by season with older lookahead blocks.

Which numbers are current?

The total columns BQ:BV are headed one season later than the blocks they sum (BQ 'Spring 2026' sums the 'Autumn 2027' block), and the Spring 2026 and Autumn 2030 blocks are not summed. Which labelling is correct?
The SUMMARY sheet refers to a SCHOOLS sheet that is not in the workbook. Was there a schools sheet that was deleted, and are schools still planned for?
Are the Community Groups quantities (5, 10, 15, 25 per species, repeated every season) real requests or a standing placeholder assumption?

Why do three species (Carex maorica, Chionochloa conspicua, Coprosma brunea) have no formulas in the master and SUMMARY, and are they in or out of the current species list (98 in the master, 95 in Community Groups, Earnslaw and Template)?
Does the 'Ref Gardens' sheet describe separate plantings from Jardine Park, or is it a copied sheet? Its lookahead numbers repeat Jardine Park's.

What are the unlabelled lookahead columns (Whitechapel AI, master columns G:I, O:Q and others), and is 'Lake Hayes South??' in the master the same site as the Lake Hayes South (9A) sheet or Lake Hayes Showground Reserve?
What does the label 'QLDC' above the Earnslaw Slipway seasons mean (landowner, funder, or recorder), and is the 'Updated 19 May 2020' totals block still used?
